headline: Citizens downgrades eBay as Depop spending, rising competition cloud outlook
summary: Investing.com -- Citizens downgraded eBay to Market Perform from Market Outperform, saying the risk-reward has become more balanced as intensifying competition in online resale and heavier investment in Depop are likely to weigh on profitability.

headline: Why eBay (EBAY) Stock Is Trading Lower Today
summary: Shares of online marketplace eBay (NASDAQ:EBAY) fell 4.7% in the afternoon session after an analyst downgrade from Wells Fargo, which lowered its rating on the company to Underweight from Equal Weight. The bank also significantly cut its price target for eBay to $92 from $105. headline: Dow Cracks 53,000 As Amazon Joins The $3T Club And Oil Does The Heavy Lifting
summary: The Dow printed a fresh record above 53,000 as a sharp slide in crude oil handed the tape a broad rally and Amazon quietly became the second US company ever to cross the three-trillion-dollar market cap threshold.
